BlueprintBench vocabulary

  {
    "domainId": "domain-fairness-subgroups",
    "title": "Fairness and subgroup testing",
    "objective": "Make quality-of-service, allocation and representational-harm evaluation a release and monitoring requirement for affected and intersectional groups.",
    "completionLevel": "governance-control-plane",
    "applicabilityQuestions": [
      "Can outcomes or service quality differ across affected groups?",
      "Does the system allocate, rank, recommend or represent people or groups?"
    ],

    "indicatorId": "kpi-provenance-coverage",

Fourteen declared invariants (14)

Source: data/semantic-invariants.json · Download full registry

[
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-01",
    "statement": "Every semantic entity has exactly one stable identifier.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "SHACL",
      "JSON Schema"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-02",
    "statement": "Every canonical definition has exactly one semantic version.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "SHACL",
      "generator"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-03",
    "statement": "Released definitions are superseded, never overwritten.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "release validation",
      "documentation"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-04",
    "statement": "Lifecycle definitions, phase definitions and gate definitions are distinct from runtime instances.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "OWL",
      "JSON Schema"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-05",
    "statement": "Every gate instance references exactly one versioned gate definition and one case.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "SHACL",
      "JSON Schema"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-06",
    "statement": "Every consequential gate decision is append-only, digest-bound and attributable.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "SHACL",
      "JSON Schema"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-07",
    "statement": "An evidence claim references exactly one artifact, one target and one case scope.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "SHACL",
      "JSON Schema"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-08",
    "statement": "Evidence evaluation is separate from evidence assertion.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "OWL",
      "SHACL"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-09",
    "statement": "Evidence bundles are manifests of digest-bound records, not duplicate evidence stores.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "SHACL",
      "JSON Schema"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-10",
    "statement": "Each cross-framework mapping represents one source version and one target version.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "SHACL",
      "JSON Schema"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-11",
    "statement": "Every assessment and evidence manifest is pinned to an immutable semantic release manifest.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "SHACL",
      "release validation"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-12",
    "statement": "Delivery status and evidence authority class remain separate properties.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "semantic spine schema",
      "browser tests"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-13",
    "statement": "Framework guidance does not create legal obligations or deployment authorization.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "authority boundary",
      "documentation"
    ]
  },
  {
    "invariantId": "SEM-14",
    "statement": "Non-authoritative monitoring signals require accountable human review before changing case state.",
    "enforcedBy": [
      "semantic spine schema",
      "module contract"
    ]
  }
]
